changes.title: Running Dry: The fight for the West's dwindling water supply | 60 Minutes Archive
changes.summary: The nation's largest reservoir, Lake Mead, has fallen to a record low. In 2021, Bill Whitaker visited the Colorado River and reported on how millions of people depend on the water to drink, power their homes, and irrigate their farms.

changes.title: Lake Mead hits historic low water level as Colorado River struggles
changes.summary: The record follows a winter that produced the worst snowpack on record in the Colorado River Basin.

changes.title: Arizona, California and Nevada would share cuts under federal proposal for Colorado River
changes.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Reclamation proposal spares four other states from facing mandatory cuts for now.

changes.title: Western states face more water cutbacks as Colorado River shrinks
changes.summary: After years of battles over its use — and a long-running drought — states that rely on the Colorado River are facing the prospect of further cutbacks. Years of gridlock among the states prompted the federal government to step in. A new blueprint lays out new requirements for managing the shrinking river. Science corres.
